content: Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of loratadine by inhibiting the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4, which is responsible for its metabolism. It is recommended to avoid this combination or consider alternative medications. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of lorlatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the lorlatinib dose by 25 mg/day. After discontinuing the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor, increase lorlatinib to the previous dose after three plasma half-lives of the inhibitor. Lorlatinib decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of clarithromycin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of clarithromycin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of lumefantrine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both clarithromycin and lumefantrine prolong the QTc interval, increasing the risk of arrhythmias. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Mavacamten decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of lurbinectedin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the lurbinectedin dose by 50%. After discontinuing the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor for five half-lives, resume the previous lurbinectedin dose. Both macimorelin and clarithromycin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Macimorelin increases the QTc interval by approximately 11 milliseconds. Avoid coadministration with drugs that prolong the QT interval, as this could increase the risk of torsades de pointes-type ventricular tachycardia. Allow sufficient washout time of QT-prolonging drugs before administering macimorelin. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of macitentan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Avoid coadministration of macitentan with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Both maprotiline and clarithromycin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of mefloquine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both clarithromycin and mefloquine prolong the QTc interval, increasing the risk of arrhythmias. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug due to the potential for increased toxicity. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of mestranol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of methadone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration of methylergonovine by inhibiting its metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of methylprednisolone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of midazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of intranasal midazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Coadministration of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors with intranasal midazolam results in higher systemic exposure to midazolam, potentially prolonging sedation. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of midostaurin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both clarithromycin and midostaurin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Mifepristone increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of clarithromycin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both clarithromycin and mifepristone prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of mirtazapine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both clarithromycin and mirtazapine prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Mitapivat decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Mitotane decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Modafinil decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of modafinil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both clarithromycin and moxifloxacin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Nefazodone increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of clarithromycin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of nefazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of nelfinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Vonoprazan decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of nelfinavir by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of neratinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Avoid coadministration of neratinib with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Pentobarbital decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of nevirapine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of nilotinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both clarithromycin and nilotinib prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of nirogacestat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both nortriptyline and clarithromycin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both clarithromycin and octreotide prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both clarithromycin and olanzapine prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Limited data, including case reports, suggest that olanzapine may rarely cause significant QTc prolongation. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of olaparib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors cannot be avoided, reduce the olaparib dose to 150 mg (capsule) or 100 mg (tablet) twice daily. Do not substitute tablets with capsules. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of omaveloxolone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the omaveloxolone dose to 50 mg/day. Monitor closely and discontinue if adverse effects occur. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir and dasabuvir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both clarithromycin and ondansetron prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Avoid in patients with congenital long QT syndrome. ECG monitoring is recommended when coadministered with other QT-prolonging medications, electrolyte abnormalities, congestive heart failure, or bradyarrhythmias. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of osimeritinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If no alternative treatment exists, monitor the patient closely for adverse effects. Both clarithromycin and oxaliplatin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration of oxycodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. A reduction in oxycodone dose may be warranted when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of palbociclib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the palbociclib dose to 75 mg/day. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of palovarotene by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both clarithromycin and panobinostat prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Panobinostat is known to significantly prolong the QT interval. Its prescribing information states that coadministration with QT-prolonging drugs is not recommended. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of pazopanib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the pazopanib dose to 400 mg/day. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of pemigatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the pemigatinib dose according to the drug monograph dosage modifications. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inhibitor for three elimination half-lives, resume the previous pemigatinib dose. Both perphenazine and clarithromycin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of pexidartinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the pexidartinib dose according to the drug monograph dosage modifications. Pexidartinib decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the effects of phenindione by inhibiting its metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Phenobarbital decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Phenytoin decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of pimavanserin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both clarithromycin and pimavanserin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of pirtobrutinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the pirtobrutinib dose by 50 mg. If the current pirtobrutinib dose is 50 mg daily, discontinue pirtobrutinib for the duration of strong CYP3A4 inhibitor use. Once the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor has been discontinued for five half-lives, resume pirtobrutinib at the dose taken before initiating the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. Both clarithromycin and pitolisant prolong the QTc interval. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of pitolisant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration of pomalidomide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and by affecting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration of ponatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors cannot be avoided, decrease the ponatinib starting dose to 30 mg daily. Both clarithromycin and ponesimod prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of pralsetinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of prednisone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of primaquine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both clarithromycin and primaquine prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Primidone decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both clarithromycin and procainamide prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both prochlorperazine and clarithromycin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of progesterone intravaginal gel by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of micronized progesterone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of natural progesterone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both promazine and clarithromycin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both promethazine and clarithromycin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both clarithromycin and propafenone prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the effects of protamine by inhibiting its metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Both protriptyline and clarithromycin prolong the QTc interval. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Clarithromycin increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of quetiapine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug.
